records.text: Owens said David Levitt sought support in 2017 for adopting a Cheyenne child and proposed a tribe-Ukraine relationship involving buffalo; she also referenced Yushchenko and 2005 while discussing Ukraine. The transcript retains a surname spelling caveat.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: he was seeking support connected to adopting a northern Native American child, a Cheyenne child, and he met with the tribal president and proposed a relationship between the tribe and Ukraine. ... OK, involving Buffalo. This is just I don't even know where else but an Erika Kirk story where you could suddenly be talking about Native Americans and Eastern Europe as we did our Erika (Erika Kirk) series and going what's going on? Why is her mom doing so much stuff on Native American reservations? ... We've got this same thread and he basically proposed to have a relationship with the president of Ukraine that we installed after the color revolution. ... And back in, when was the color revolution? Back in 2005, Yushchenko (Viktor Yushchenko), he pitched this proposal for the tribe to have a relationship with Ukraine.
